sloka: युध्यमानौ तु तौ दृष्ट्वा प्रसक्तौ नराक्षसौ।प्रभिन्नाविव मातङ्गौ परस्परवधैषिणौ ।। ६.९०.१ ।।
transliteration: yudhyamānau tu tau dṛṣṭvā prasaktau narākṣasau।prabhinnāviva mātaṅgau parasparavadhaiṣiṇau ।। 6.90.1 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana (man) and Indrajith (Rakshasa) were fond of battle and intending to win in the fight overcoming each other. Each of them were like elephants but were broken into pieces. Vibheeshana, with eagerness to witness the battle stood in the forefront of the battlefield watching the fight.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्ड का चौरासी सग पूरा हुआ । ज २) 22) पञ्चाशीतितमः सगः + ७३० ना 0222 तस्य तद्वचनं शरुत्वा राघवः शोककशितः । नोपधारयते व्यक्तं यदुक्तं तेन रक्षसा
